summary: Couple hiking the Wulfshon Trail above the Glenwood Springs Community Center strayed off trail and the woman became cliffed out about thirty yards below her partner; GSAR technical rope rescue raised her back to safe ground and both hikers returned safely
location: Wulfshon Trail above Glenwood Springs Community Center, Glenwood Springs
responding_agency: Garfield County Search and Rescue (Garfield County Sheriff's Office); Glenwood Springs Fire Department
notes: Activated shortly after 1 PM 2022-08-16; SAR member reached the stranded hiker ~5:30 PM; Glenwood Springs Fire Department paramedics assisted; sheriff drone provided aerial photos.
